build_LSTM_module: build a multi-layer LSTM recurrent neural network module with configurable hidden size, layers, and dropout
create_MultiAgentLSTM: create a multi-agent LSTM network supporting centralized training with shared or independent agent parameters
build_Lstm_model: build a BenchMARL Lstm model that processes tensor inputs through an LSTM followed by an MLP head
create_LstmConfig: create an LstmConfig dataclass to configure LSTM hidden size, layers, dropout, bias, and MLP parameters
test_get_net: test the get_net function to instantiate and optionally compile an LSTM network with given hyperparameters
